name: Rebbachisaurus
sum: Rebbachisaurus is a rebbachisaurid sauropod from the mid-Cretaceous Kem Kem Beds of Morocco, the genus that gives its name to the family.
wsnote: Once thought to reach 20 m; more recent estimates give about 14 m and 7-12 t (Wikipedia revision).
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; a skeleton found in 1948 in Errachidia Province, Morocco, with very tall dorsal vertebrae (up to about 150 cm).
material: A partial skeleton from the Kem Kem Beds with associated and referred vertebrae and limb bones.
biology: Like other rebbachisaurids, a four-legged herbivore with a long neck ending in a relatively large head.
author: Lavocat 1954
